persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.Meaning of cleanup: Clear the loose clutter off the counter, not a renovation.

messages.text: Can you clean up this kitchen pic by clearing the loose clutter off the counter, rather than doing a renovation? I keep getting distracted by the mess when I look at it, so I’d love to see it tidied up. You can decide which loose items to remove, but please keep the brown cabinets, beige tiles, counter material and existing kitchen layout as they are. I just mean a cleanup of what’s sitting out, with the image staying a realistic photo in the same wide framing. Free-tier resolution is fine.
